seo.title: Affiliated Organizations · Ontario Rare Action Group
seo.description: Many rare disease organizations across Ontario partner with us on advocacy, research and patient support and we are adding new partners all the time. Together, we are stronger.

header.title: We do this work together.
header.lede: Many rare disease organizations across Ontario partner with us on advocacy, research and patient support. Each one brings deep expertise in their condition area — together, we represent more than a million Ontarians.

partners.name: The Canadian Addison Society
partners.focus: Support, education and advocacy for Canadians with Addison's disease and adrenal insufficiency.

partners.name: ALS Society of Canada
partners.focus: Research funding, community support and advocacy for people living with ALS.

partners.focus: Patient-led education and advocacy for people living with arthritis.

partners.name: Canadian XLH Network
partners.focus: Awareness, advocacy and support for people living with X-linked hypophosphatemia.

partners.name: Chronic Myeloid Leukemia Society of Canada
partners.focus: Support, education and treatment information for people living with CML.

partners.name: Canadian Pulmonary Fibrosis Foundation

partners.name: Cure SMA Canada

partners.name: Defeat Duchenne Canada

partners.name: Langerhans cell histiocytosis Association of Canada

partners.name: MitoCanada

becomePartner.title: Run a rare-disease organization in Ontario? Let's talk.
becomePartner.body: We host a quarterly leaders' roundtable, share advocacy updates, and amplify member campaigns. Affiliation is free.
